title: Record page v4: same-shaped related panels with no collapse, a persistent tab row under the header (the enlarged state is the active tab), Activity as the first panel and a tab, one top bar on every face, tiers by container width
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

Part of the record-page epic #26676 — the v4 record page, **final design** (the maintainer, 2026-10-29: 「设计定稿：按画布 60 重写 #27524 / #27545 的 Target 并回队列」). Design boards: evidence branch `claude/record-page-v2-evidence-20261027b` @ `a7825499aa`, folder `docs/design/record-page-v2-2026-10-27/v4/` — `RecordPageV4Panels.dc.html` (lead, 1440 page, arrived from the list ↗), `RecordPageV4TwoCol.dc.html` (lead, 1200), `RecordPageV4Product.dc.html` (product, no list trail), `RecordPageV4Enlarged.dc.html` (the 任务 tab active on the page), `RecordDrawerV4Peek.dc.html` (contact in the default split pane, 720), `RecordDrawerV4Max.dc.html` (the pane maximized), `RecordDrawerV4Enlarged.dc.html` (the 任务 tab active inside the pane), `RecordMobile.dc.html` (390), `notes.md` n41–n51 (n50 = the tab row, n51 = the HotCRM audit). Read with `git show a7825499aa:<path>`; never merge that branch. Sibling card #27545 owns the split / overlay / maximize mechanics; this card owns the page's anatomy. The boards were audited against HotCRM's declared metadata (highlightFields, inbound lookups, fieldGroups, page actions, view columns) — build to the metadata, the boards only illustrate it.

## Source (main `273137d227`, after PR #27310 / #27473)

- Related cards carry a title, count, and three always-visible icon buttons (＋ ⤢ ⋯); collapse, hide and keyboard move live in the ⋯ menu; drag has no hover affordance. Ten cards on a HotCRM contact, four of them with 0 rows, each taking a full card.
- The header action row ends with a segmented 「时间线 | 关联」 text control; a crumb row above the header carries ‹ back and ↑ ↓.
- Three tiers: three columns (details | resident timeline | related) above 1120, two columns with a 「相关 N」 rail toggle above 760, a tabbed tier (详情 / 时间线 / 关联) below; the embedded record is always the tabbed tier.
- Enlarging a related list (`?related=`) replaces the page body; the timeline is a resident column for worked objects (`recordTimelineDefaultReason`, #27052).

## Target (maintainer rulings of 2026-10-29, verbatim where quoted; not re-decidable here)

1. **Panel header.** Title, then the count chip. Clicking the header row (or the chip) switches to that panel's tab (item 8); on hover the title end shows ›, the tooltip reads 「查看全部 N 条」. On hover the RIGHT end shows ⠿ (drag to reorder with a drop line; focused, ⌥↑ / ⌥↓), ＋ (new) and ⋯ holding 隐藏 only. **No collapse chevron, no collapse, no ⤢** (「右侧关联区域的折叠也不需要了吧」— ruled yes; the tab is the enlarged face). Nothing is reserved on the left when not hovered.
2. **Empty panels** (0 rows) fold into one line 「还有 N 个空关联 · 名字 · … · 展开」; non-empty panels keep their order.
3. **Column foot** 「已隐藏 N 张 · 显示 · 恢复默认顺序」 (restores order and hidden).
4. **The right-column switch ⊟** (「右栏」, `⌘⇧,`) lives in the top bar (item 7), drawn only when the face's tier has a right column; the segmented text control goes.
5. **动态 (was 时间线): a panel and a tab, never a column.** The merged stream (comments, activity, history — #27055's merger) is the FIRST panel of the right column: a one-line composer, the newest 3 entries (5 at ≥ 1120), 「查看全部 N 条 →」 which opens the 动态 tab. The 动态 tab is the full stream with the filter chips 全部 · 活动 · 讨论 · 变更 and paging, URL `?related=timeline`. The resident timeline column, the ⊞ / ⊟ promotion and `recordTimelineDefaultReason` retire (「宽屏时间线放中间不需要了吧」— ruled yes). Naming: 「动态」 in zh, 「Activity」 in en, across the ten i18n packs; `record.timeline.*` keys keep their ids, their values change.
6. **Tiers — one rule by the container's own width.** ≥ 760 px: details | right column (320 px); ≥ 1120 px: the same, with the details field grid at 3 columns, the right column 380 px and the 动态 panel showing 5. < 760 px (split pane at 720, phone): ONE column — details sections, then the right column's panels in their order; no tab tier (「同意」 to the stack). The three-column tier, the tabbed tier and the 「相关 N」 rail retire. The embedded record (split pane, overlay drawer, maximized) and the phone use the same rule.
7. **One top bar on every face** (40 px, above the record header; frame controls only). Left: breadcrumb 「对象 › 记录名」 — clicking the object name returns to the list (in the drawer one level down: 「← 路径」 as #26679 drew). Right, fixed order, each drawn only when it applies: the counter 「3 / 21」 + ↓ ↑ (only with a list context — the pane always, the page only when it arrived with a `?from=` list trail; the counter's tooltip names the scope: the view's name, or the group when the list was grouped / a kanban column); ⊟ (item 4); ⤢ / ⤡ (the pane's maximize / restore, #27545; on the page ⤡ 「收为抽屉」 only for readers who arrived through the row ↗); ✕ (pane faces only; always closes the whole path; never on the page). The header action row holds business actions only (1 primary + 2 secondary + ⋯, in the page's declared order). The crumb row and the small ‹ line above the title go.
8. **A persistent tab row at the bottom edge of the header block**, on every face: 「概览」 then one tab per panel — 动态 first, then the related panels in the arrangement's order — each with its count. The visible count is COMPUTED from the row's container width (ResizeObserver; recomputed on resize, sidebar collapse, pane drag): as many as fit, the rest in a 「+N ▾」 dropdown that lists them with counts; the active tab is always visible (it swaps into the last visible slot); 概览 always visible plus at least one more. Hidden panels' tabs sit at the end of the dropdown. Order and visibility follow `record.related.arrangement`. (「关联多他不是也折叠到下拉了吗」; 「显示几个相关表 tab 应该根据实际的屏幕宽度计算吧」.)
9. **The enlarged state is the active tab.** Top bar and record header unchanged; below the tab row the full-width table (all columns, paging, sort, inline edit where the FK allows — the child object's list face) fills the remaining height; URL `?related=object.field`; Esc or 概览 returns. Not a modal, not a drill-down level, no path in the top bar, no compacted header. Inside the pane it fills the pane body the same way; maximizing the pane widens it in place.
10. **Stored arrangement** `record.related.arrangement` = `{ v, order, hidden, basedOn, seen }` — `collapsed` is removed with no compatibility read (startup posture: no staged retirement). No metadata key is added.
11. **Compact row's first column** skips the FK that points back at this record (a product's line items name the opportunity, not the product). Unchanged from the earlier ruling.
12. **Highlights** are the object's declared `highlightFields` minus the name field (the title), max 6 — the boards show HotCRM's declared sets (lead: 公司 · 邮箱 · 线索状态 · 线索负责人; contact: 邮箱 · 客户 · 电话; product: 产品编号 · 产品名称 · 类别 · 启用). The contact object has no status field; nothing invents one.

## File surface

`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedCardStack.tsx`, `RecordPageColumns.tsx`, `synth/recordPageColumns.ts`, `synth/relatedArrangement.ts`, `useRelatedArrangement.ts`, `RelatedListEmptyFold.tsx`, `synth/recordTimelineStream.ts` (the promotion retires), `ArrangedRelatedTab.tsx` (retires), a new tab-row component beside them, `ui/packages/components/src/custom/panel-toggles.tsx` (retires or reduces to the one ⊟ icon) + `renderers/layout/containers.tsx` (the top-bar slot), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordDrawerStack.tsx` (tier by container width), i18n in all ten packs, tests beside, changeset; ⛔ `packages/spec/**`; ⛔ the split / overlay / maximize mechanics (#27545). **Serial-after** #27056 (ui seat 1, branch `claude/project-thread-g0nswr`): its file surface overlaps this one (`RelatedCardStack`, `RecordPageColumns`, `synth/recordPageColumns`, `useRelatedArrangement`, `RelatedListEmptyFold`, `recordDrawerStack`) — claim after its PR is merged, or branch from it and say so.

## Acceptance

1. Tests per target item: header anatomy (no chevron, header click = tab, hover ⠿ ＋ ⋯); keyboard reorder on the handle; empty fold line; foot; ⊟ only when a right column exists; 动态 as panel + tab, no promotion; the tier rule at 1440 / 1200 / 720 / 390 (the stack has no tab tier); the top bar's left and right ends per face; the tab row's visible count at three widths with the active tab always visible; the enlarged state keeps the header; the arrangement shape without `collapsed`; the compact row's first column; highlights = declared fields minus the name.
2. Screenshots on HotCRM against the boards — lead at 1440 (from the list ↗, with the trail) and 1200; contact in the split pane at 720, maximized, and with the 任务 tab active in the pane and on the page; product at 1440; a 390 phone — on a never-merged evidence branch, linked from the PR body.
3. The epic seat verifies the PR in the console preview against the boards before ACCEPT (maintainer: 「车队开发完后你审核效果」).
4. #26678 / #27052 / #27055 / #27473 / #26679 pins updated to the new anatomy, not deleted.

<sub>Rewritten by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` on 2026-10-29 after the maintainer's 定稿 on canvas version 60; the earlier Target of this card (v4 panels, 2026-10-29 morning) is superseded in full.</sub>
